narrative_purpose: The base image for a labeled diagram showing that one zircon crystal holds two ages: a bright glowing inner core (first crystallization) and a distinct paler overgrowth rim (a later event). Labels are added in the interface, so the image itself carries no text.
subject: A single large zircon crystal shown as a polished cross-section, elongated and faceted. Inside it, clearly concentric zones: a bright, warm-glowing inner core positioned left-of-center and a little low in the frame, surrounded by fine growth bands, and then a visibly distinct, paler, cooler overgrowth rim wrapping the upper-right shoulder of the crystal. The two zones differ in hue and brightness so they read as two separate growth episodes.
scene: The crystal floating alone against a deep dark field, lit as a precious specimen, faint dust motes drifting.
camera: Straight-on macro of the cut crystal face, filling most of the frame, flat enough that overlaid labels can sit cleanly beside the core and the rim.
light: Internal bioluminescent-style glow: a brighter cyan-amber core and a dimmer, cooler teal rim; deep indigo shadow around the crystal.
palette: Void-indigo background, cyan and teal glowing zones, a scarce ember-amber heart in the core, mist highlights on facets.
style: Painterly specimen plate with a clean, study-like clarity; textured but legible zones.
detail_level: Crisp, clearly separated core and rim zones with visible concentric growth bands; background plain dark so labels stay readable over it.
composition: Crystal centered and large; the bright core sitting around the left-center of the frame and the paler rim around the upper-right shoulder, leaving open dark space beside each for callout labels added later.
consistency_notes: Same glowing zircon motif as the cover and fig-01 (bright core, paler rim). Keep the background simple and dark so interface labels overlay cleanly. Cool Pandora palette.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no arrows, no callout dots or leader lines, no infographic chrome, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares
